rationale: The agent appears to have identified the user via name and ZIP and accessed the user’s orders, but then executed order-changing actions without first confirming with the user, violating the policy. It modified a watch item and updated an order address, and charged a credit card for an air purifier change, all reported as already done with no prior confirmation. Additionally, the user stated the purifier was already received; the agent used a pending-order modification tool instead of initiating an exchange/return process. The final summary is truncated and does not clearly confirm color preference handling. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy and the final information is not fully supported or properly confirmed.
